ability.name: Step 5 — Port and Service Discovery
ability.description: Performs localized connection scanning on discovered live hosts targeting active directory and typical administration interfaces.

stages.command_template:
$d='C:\Windows\Temp as'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { if (Test-Path "C:\Windows\Temp as\live_hosts.txt") { $hosts = Get-Content "C:\Windows\Temp as\live_hosts.txt" } else { $hosts = @("192.168.187.1", "192.168.187.141", "192.168.127.22") }; $hosts | Out-File -FilePath "C:\Windows\Temp as
map_targets.txt" -Encoding ascii; & nmap -sT -sV -Pn -p 21,22,25,53,80,88,110,135,139,143,389,443,445,587,636,1433,3268,3269,3306,3389,5432,5985,5986,8080,8443,8888 --version-intensity 5 --min-rate 200 --max-retries 2 -oX "C:\Windows\Temp as
map_services.xml" -iL "C:\Windows\Temp as
map_targets.txt"; "Port scan completed" } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath C:\Windows\Temp as\step5.txt

rationale: Targets verified active IPs via TCP connect scans and banner pulls to find active domain interfaces safely.
